spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Chapter
 of
 the Five
 Rulers


---


**
¶1:**

Once
 again divine
 wisdom,
 made
 manifest,
 opens
 the interior
 sense
 to
 those who
 receive
 it:


**
¶2:**
Five origins
 of
 evil
 have existed
 from
 the very
 beginning within
 the realm of complete
 spiritual
 fals
ity. Five fundamental
 falsities p
oured forth from those
 origins
. From
 those
 five fundamental
 falsities were formed
 five
 perv
erted perceptions —
 entire
 ways
 of seeing
 reality
 inv
erted. From those five perverted per
ceptions were formed five classes of evil aff
ections in
 each spiritual
 state
,
 both
 in
 the will
 and in
 the understanding.
 And
 the
 five states
 of
 spiritual darkness themselves each
 possess a
 ruling
 love
 within
 them,
 and an
 anim
ating falsity,
 an
 external
 form, and a quality by
 which they are
 inter
iorly appropriated —
 and
 in
 no
 state
 do these
 res
emble one another.


**¶3:**
The
 ruling
 love
 of the
 state
 of dense
 obsc
urity —
 the deep
est falsity that
 rises
 from
 the a
byss of spiritual ignor
ance — this
 is what pres
ides over all wick
edness and all malice
. The origin
 of all spiritual warfare
 proceeded
 from this love
;
 every
 conflict
 of
 the
 understanding
, every assault
 upon the will
, every cont
ention,
 pe
ril, devast
ation, and
 struggle
 within
 the spirit
.
 This
 ruling
 love first
 brought
 forth host
ility and war among
 its
 own
 states and
 its
 own derivative
 powers. Afterward
 it
 also w
aged war against
 divine
 wisdom
 itself
. It raised
 itself
 in
 battle
 against the heav
enly kingdom.

**¶4
:**
Now concerning
 this
 ruling principle
 of spiritual
 darkness, there are five forms
 upon it. Its governing
 thought
 is the
 form
 of self-love in
 its domin
ion. Its powers
 of
 action are the forms
 of infernal cr
uelty.
 Its supporting
 strength
 is the form of intellectual pride that
 ex
alts itself.
 Its interior process
 of
 appropri
ation is the form of sensory fals
ity that dev
ours all
 truth. Its lowest
 and
 final
 expression is the form of perv
erted natural knowledge,
 g
rasping only
 the
 ou
termost appearances
 of the
 world.
 These
 five forms,
 the marks of its five spiritual
 states, exist upon the ruling principle
 of the
 real
ms of fals
ity.

**¶5:**

Now there are five further
 qualities
 within
 it. The first is its total
 absence
 of wisdom. The second is its spiritual
 corruption —
 the decay
 of everything
 good
 within
 it. The third is its de
formity —
 for
 all
 spiritual
 beauty
,
 which
 is the form
 of good, is absent
 from it. The fourth is the
 deep
 bitterness that
 constit
utes its very
 animating love. The fifth is its
 consuming
 self
-love, which burns within
 it like mol
ten metal
,
 as
 though
 p
oured forth
 from the
 fire
 of the
 love
 of self.

**¶6
:**
There
 are also three further
 things
 within it. The first:
 that
 its external
 form
 is imp
ervious and
 u
nyielding to
 all
 truth —
 utt
erly hard
ened —
 for
 the
 love
 of self and
 the world has
 fash
ioned it so
,
 cruel
 in
 its very
 will
;
 namely,
 the
 love
 of what
 is one
's own,
 which
 is the thought of spiritual
 death,
 the love
 that
 shaped
 this
 ruling
 principle
 out
 of the very
 nature of the realm
 of fals
ity. This is the character
 of the external
 form of the chief
 of dense
 obsc
urity. It
 is harder than every hard
ened
 fals
ity,
 every
 natural
 resistance
, every rigid
 persu
asion;
 for
 there is no truth
 that
 can penet
rate it, no instrument
 of
 the
 understanding that can divide
 it. For the love of what
 is one's own,
 its
 fashioner, has formed
 it imp
enet
rable and
 unyielding.

**
¶7:**
The second: that
 it wounds and destro
ys the
 spiritual
 life
 through
 the
 power
 of its persu
asive
 fals
ity. Its doc
trines and teachings
, all its foolish instruction
, produce
 ench
antment
 and binding
 spells upon
 the
 mind
. When it w
ills, it can cast
 a
 persu
asion over itself and
,
 through its arts
 of fals
ity, become
 hidden from those
 in
 the
 same
 spiritual state —
 appearing
 as though it does
 not exist.
 Again, when it wills, it
 can manifest
 itself
 over its derivative
 powers and appear openly
 to them
.
 So that those
 arts
 of persu
asive
 falsity which
 people practice
 in
 the
 present
 world
 are the secret
 work
ings of this
 ruling principle
 of spiritual darkness. Concerning this,
 wisdom
 commands at
 all times:
 Withdraw
 from the persu
asive arts and
 enchantments of fals
ity! For any person who learns
 them,
 and who practices
 and brings
 them to completion —
 at the last, in the state
 where the ruling principle of the
 realms of falsity is bound with
 all
 its powers, there also
 will
 be bound the
 spirit
 of whoever has lived freely among such
 fals
ities
 and walked in the persu
asive arts of spiritual
 error. Whether it is the
 understanding
 or the will, this is the judgment
 given, decre
ed from
 the
 Divine
 judgment
:
 that
 whoever practices
 these
 things
 will
 share
 the
 state
 of their
 ruling principle.

**¶8
:**
The third: that the ruling
 principle of the realms of falsity
 knows the discourse
 and
 the
 language of all
 its five spiritual
 states. It compreh
ends everything it
 perce
ives from the
 expressions
 of its
 derivative
 forms
 as
 they communicate
 with
 one another,
 each in
 its own mode
.
 Every design they conce
ive against it, every strat
agem they deliber
ate among
 themselves to bring upon it, it knows
.
 It can also interpret
 the subtle
 signals
 they
 make
 between themselves
. Yet its
 own
 derivative
 powers and rulers
, which
 are subject to it, cannot comprehend
 its own
 form
 of discourse. While all these external
 things are unveiled to it —
 still, the
 interior
 will
 is not manifest
 to it.
 It knows not the
 mind nor the thought of what
 is within
;
 it cannot
 f
athom the origin
 or
 the purpose
 of anything
. Rather, it only knows and app
rehends what is immediately
 before its perception
 —
 what
 is present
 to
 the
 senses alone
.

**¶9:**

Also, another quality
 is found in the ruling
 principle of the realms of falsity
.
 When it wills to act
, it extends
 all its powers
 out
ward and advances
. When it w
ills otherwise
, it withdraws its
 powers and draws
 them
 in
ward and
 contracts
 into
 a
 dense
 mass
 among
 its companions,
 falling
 into
 the lowest
 state
 like
 a concentrated
 drop
 of evil
 or
 a great weight
 of hard
ened
 falsity. It terrifies by its
 outc
ry;
 it is d
readful. It sh
akes
 its
 derivative
 powers with its force
 —
 for
 when it speaks, it is like the
 overwhelming
 sound of fals
ity rever
berating through obsc
ured
 states
 of
 mind
,
 like
 the cr
ashing of rigid
 persu
asions
. When it cries out and calls
 over
 its powers
, they tr
emble and t
otter and fall beneath
 it
 — even
 as aff
ections for
 truth
 would be scattered
 and
 fall
 to the lowest
 natural
 state.
 Yet
 this one
 thing remains
: it knows not what is distant
 from it;
 it perce
ives not what
 is remote
,
 nor does it compreh
end it
. Only
 what
 is immediately before
 its face does
 it perceive,
 app
rehending and
 knowing it.

**¶10
:**
These characteristics
 and these evil marks are found in the
 chief of all
 evil
 aff
ections and
 hostile
 fals
ities —
 the ruling
 principle of all
 the ex
alted states
 of spiritual darkness —
 the one to whom the realm of fals
ity has given birth, begotten in
 its cruelty, its
 wickedness,
 and its wrath.

**
¶11:**
This
 ruling
 evil
 exce
eds all its
 fellow ruling
 principles
 that
 exist
 within
 all its spiritual states.

**
¶12:**
The
 sem
blance of celest
ial good
 —
 gold in
 its perv
erted correspondence
 — is the external
 form of the ruling principle of the
 realms of falsity. The external
 form of all the powers belonging
 to the state
 of dense obscurity is this
 same
 count
erfeit of
 celestial good. And
 the
 quality
 of its works
 is bar
ren
ness — a
 desire
 for truth dev
oid of all good. The anim
ating fals
ity of this
 ruling principle
 is the
 one
 that reigns today
 in the governing
 powers
 and authorities of the world
 and
 the entire natural
 order
 —
 namely
, those
 who rule over the whole
 of
 creation, degrad
ing the
 truly
 human with tyranny according
 to the
 desires of self
-
love.

**¶13:**

In contrast, the ruling principle of
 the states
 of consuming
 self
-love bears
 the form
 of self
-love in its domin
ance
 —
 the fore
most of all evil
 affections. Perv
erted natural good
 is
 its
 external
 form. The
 external
 form of all the rulers belonging to consuming
 self-love is this same dist
orted natural
 good
ness. The
 quality of their
 works is dist
ortion — fals
ity that s
ours
 and
 corru
pts every
 form of
 truth
. The animating spirit
 of this ruling love
 is the one
 that reigns in the powerful
 and the leaders who
 serve
 under
 the
 governing
 authorities
 and
 the kings of the world. A
 spirit of this same
 love
 is also
 found in those
 doc
trines that worship self
-love directly
, whose
 devot
ions
 and
 sacrifices are offered to the
 fire
 of their
 own desire
.

**¶14:**

Again, the ruling principle of the states
 of self
-derived
 reasoning
 bears
 the form of intellectual pride.
 Hard
ened fals
ity —
 imp
ervious to truth — is its external
 form. The external form of all who
 belong
 to self
-derived reasoning is this same rigid
 fals
ity. The quality of their works is
 sh
arpness — a cutting fals
ity that divides and separates in
 every form. Its
 animating spirit is the spirit
 of idolatry toward
 self
-originated
 ideas
 —
 the spirits
 of error found
 in every temple of
 the
 mind
 where
 self
-made
 thoughts
 are worshipped, every
 place
 where
 images and
 concepts
 fash
ioned by one
's own intelligence
 are venerated —
 the shrines of the world
's
 spiritual
 error.

**¶15:**

For its
 part, the ruling principle of the state
 of fals
ified truth bears the form of perv
erted natural knowledge. Falsified spiritual
 truth — silver
 in its corrupt
 correspondence — is its external form. All
 the other rulers who
 belong to falsified truth likewise
 bear the appearance
 of spiritual
 truth. The quality of their works is
 a
 false
 sweet
ness — a
 pleas
antness that attracts and
 flatters in
 every form. The animating spirit of
 this ruling principle is the one
 that reigns today
 in the doc
trines of error
 — those that practice
 the pur
ification of the external
 mind
 alone
, placing
 all
 their hope and trust in out
ward ritual
 cle
ansing, believing
 that the washing
 of
 the natural
 understanding
 is
 sufficient
 without
 any interior
 transformation
 of
 the will
.

**¶16:**

Again, the ruling principle of the state
 of fundamental
 sens
ory falsity is
 a consuming
 fals
ity from
 evil
 in
 its deep
est form. The bas
est and
 heaviest falsities
 — lead and tin — are its external
 form
. All
 the other rulers belonging
 to this
 state of
 fundamental darkness
 likewise
 bear these
 bas
est fals
ities as
 their form
. The quality of their works is deep
 bitterness.
 The animating spirit that
 reigns in them is the spirit that
 speaks to
 this day
 through
 those
 who claim
 interior
 knowledge from
 inf
ernal sources — those who give
 signs
 and port
ents of
 every
 kind
, those
 who are possessed by
 fals
ities
 from
 evil, and all
 the other
 spirits that pronoun
ce hidden
 things
 from
 the realm
 of darkness
,
 of
 every
 type.

**¶17:**

Concerning all
 this,
 wisdom
 declares
: my
 kind
red and my members
, the perf
ected
 faithful, the consec
rated who
 are set
 apart — guard
 the
 interior will close
 within
 you, and hold
 your
selves apart
 from the five ens
lavements of the five spirits
 of fals
ity. Put behind you the service of
 their five external
 forms
. Do
 not live within
 those
 states
, so that you may break their
 bond
age and their affl
iction forever
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Once again the enlightener speaks to his disciples:

Five storehouses have arisen since the beginning in the land of darkness! The five elements poured out of them. Also, from the five elements were fashioned the five trees! Again, from the five trees were fashioned the five genera of creatures in each world, male and female. And the five worlds themselves have five kings therein, and five spirits, five bodies, five tastes; in each world, they not resembling one another!

The King of the world of Smoke [is the chief of them all,] who came up from the depth of darkness; this is he who is the head of all wickedness, and all malignity. The beginning of the spread of the war occured through him; all the battles, fights, quarrelling, dangers, destructions, fights, wrestling-contests! That is the one who first made arise danger and war, with his worlds and his powers. Afterwards, also, he waged war with the light. He pitched a battle with the exalted kingdom.

Now, regarding the King of Darkness, there are five shapes on him! His head is lion-faced; his hands and feet are demon- and devil-faced; his shoulders are eagle-faced; while his belly is dragon-faced; his tail is fish-faced. These five shapes, the marks of his five worlds, exist on the King of the realms of Darkness!

Now, there are five other properties in him. The first is his darkness. The second is his putridity. The third is his ugliness. The fourth is his bitterness, his own soul. The fifth is his burning, which burns like an iron () as if poured out from fire.

[There are] also three others in him! The first, that his body is hard and very tough, even as she has formed him [to be] cruel-hearted; namely Matter, who is the thought of death, [the o]ne who sculpted him from the nature of the land of darkness. This is the manner of the body of the ruler of Smoke. He is harder than every iron, copper and steel and lead; as there is no cleaver at all, nor any iron implement, can [pierce] him and cut him. For Matter, his fashioner, has formed him [to be] strong and hard.

The third, that the King of the realms of Darkness knows the converse and language of his five worlds. He understands every thing he hears from their mouths, as they address one another; each one of them in his language. [Every] design they will consider against him, every snare they debate with one another to bring upon him, he knows them! He can also understand the gesturing they signal between one another. Yet, his powers and his rulers, who are subject to him, can not understand his wordy converse. While all these things are unveiled to him; still, their heart is not manifested to him. He knows not their mind nor their thought; he can not ponder their beginning and their end. Rather, he only knows and apprehends what is before his eyes.

Also, another different thing is found in the King of the realms of Darkness! For when it pleases him to move, he spreads all his limbs out and walks. When it comes to mind, he with[d]raws his limbs and takes them in, and is rolled (?) to his companions; and he falls to the ground like a grape and a great iron ball! He terrifies by his cry, he is frightful. He frightens his powers with his sound; because when he speaks, being like thunder in the clouds, he resembles the [crashing] of the rocks [upon one another.] When he cries out and [roars] and calls [out] over his powers, they shall tremble and to[tter a]nd fall under foot; even as some birds would be [struck down by] the bird [of prey when it descends upon them, and they scatter] and they fall down to the earth. Still, this thing only: he knows not what is far from him, he sees not who is at a distance, nor does he hear him. Rather, whoever is before his face he sees, hearing him and knowing him.

These signs and these evil marks are found in the chief of the demons and fiends, the King of all the mountains of Darkness[. He is the one] to [whom] the land of darkness has given birth, begotten in its cruelty, in its wickedness and its wrath[, from the beginning.]
[He is more mighty and more wicked] more than all his fellow rulers, who are in all his worlds.

Gold is the body of the King of the realms of Darkness. The body of all the powers who belong to the world of Smoke is gold. And also, the taste of its fruits is salty. The spirit of the King, of the realms of Darkness, is this one who reigns today in the principalities and authorities of the earth and the entire universe. I mean these who reign over the entire creation, humiliating mankind with tyranny, according to their heart's desire.

In contrast, the King of the worlds of Fire is lion-faced, the foremost of all the beasts. Copper is his body. Again, the body of all the rulers who belong to Fire is copper. Their taste is the sour taste that is in every form. Also, the spirit of the King, of they that belong to the world of Fire, is this one who reigns in the greater ones and the leaders; who are under the command of the principalities and authorities and the kings of the world. Also a spirit of his is found in these sects that worship fire, as their sacrifices are offered to fire.

Again, the King of the worlds of Wind is eagle-face. His body is iron. Also, the body of all they who belong to the Wind is iron. Their taste is the sharp taste that is in every form. His spirit is the one of idolatry to the spirits of error who are in every temple, the sites of idols, the sites of statue- and image-worship, the shrines of the error of the world.

For his part, the King of the world of Water is fish-face. His body is silver. All the other rulers who belong to Water, silver is their body. Also, the taste of their fruit is the sweetness of water, the sweet taste that is in every (form). Again, the spirit of the King, of the rulers of Water, is this one who reigns today in the sects of error; these that dip the baptism of the waters, (setting) their hope and their trust in the baptism of the waters.

Again, [the Kin]g of the world of Darkness is a dragon. His [body is lead] and tin. All the other rulers [who belong to the world of] Darkness, their body is lead and tin. And also, the taste of their fruits is bitterness. Again, the spirit who reigns in them is the spirit who speaks till today in the soothsayers, giving oracles; in the givers of portents, every type; in they who are possessed; and the other spirits that give oracles, every type.

Concerning this I tell you, my brethren and my limbs, the perfect faithful, the holy elect: Hold your heart close to you, and you stay away from the five enslavements of the five dark spirits. Put behind you the service of their five bodies. Live not in them, that you may break loose their chain and their chastening for ever!

The second, that he wounds and kills by the word of his magic arts. His recitation and hearing, all his foolish instruction, make magic and invocations for him. When it pleases him, he can make an invocation over himself, and by his magic arts be hidden from his companions. Again, when it pleases him, he can be manifested over his powers and appear to them; so that these enchantments nowadays, which people utilise (?) [ ... ] this world, are the mysteries of the King of Darkness. Concerning this, I command you all the time: Keep away from the magic arts and enchantments of darkness! For any person who will be taught them, and who does and accomplishes them; at the last, in the place where will be bound the King of the realms of Darkness with his powers, there they will bind that one also, the soul of whoever has lived freely among them and walked in the [magic ar]ts of error. Whether it is a man or a woman, this is the sentence given, cut [ ... f]rom God's judgement, that whoever will [ ... ] with their King.
